events.text: Herod the Great rules for Rome and rebuilds the temple.
Jesus is crucified and rises (about AD 30).
The Jerusalem church is poor; Paul collects money for it from the Gentile churches.
Revolt against Rome from AD 66; the temple destroyed in AD 70.
Claudius expels Jews from Rome (about AD 49); Nero becomes emperor in AD 54.
A year of civil war, then Vespasian.
Written from Macedonia, about AD 55 to 56

teaser.title: 1 Corinthians is sent
teaser.text: Paul writes from Ephesus, about AD 54 to 55.

teaser.title: 2 Corinthians is written
teaser.text: After a painful visit and a severe letter, Paul writes from Macedonia, about AD 55 to 56.

teaser.title: Paul reaches Corinth
teaser.text: Paul spends three months in Greece, then writes Romans (Acts 20:2-3).
